t: What he told the bedouins who asked whether treatment was allowed
a: تَدَاوَوْا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سُبْحَانَهُ لَمْ يَضَعْ دَاءً إِلاَّ وَضَعَ مَعَهُ شِفَاءً
p: Tadāwaw ʿibāda-Llāh, fa-inna-Llāha subḥānahu lam yaḍaʿ dāʾan illā waḍaʿa maʿahu shifāʾan
m: Seek treatment, servants of Allah. Allah has put down no disease without putting down a cure with it.
